empty.title: Something good starts here.
empty.body: Your bag is still empty. Find the one that feels like you.

payment.noteRedirect: You will finish paying on a secure Stripe page. The store never receives your card details.
payment.noteManual: Place your order without entering card details. Price and stock are checked when you confirm.

checkout.mixedCurrencies: Your bag has items in different currencies. Place a separate order for each currency.
checkout.refreshed: Prices and availability updated. Review your bag before confirming.
checkout.footnoteRedirect: Payment confirmation is verified on the server.
checkout.footnoteManual: You are not charged at this step.

recovery.title: Let's continue with the same order.
recovery.body: We kept your bag and the reference from your previous attempt. First we will check its status so you don't end up with a duplicate order.
recovery.footnote: Coming back from the payment page neither confirms nor cancels a payment.
recovery.cancelledNotice: The previous attempt is now closed. Check prices and availability before placing a new order. If you see a charge on your bank statement, contact the store.
recovery.corruptNotice: We could not recover the reference for your previous payment. Contact the store before placing another order.

receipt.title: Almost yours.
receipt.body: We saved your order. Payment and delivery will be arranged with the store.
receipt.note: Keep this reference to check on your order. You have not been charged.

recovered.confirmedBody: The server confirmed the payment for this attempt. The store will arrange delivery.
recovered.receivedBody: Your order was already saved. Manual payment and delivery will be arranged with the store.
recovered.note: We recovered your original order without creating another.

body.confirmed: The server confirmed the payment. The store will arrange delivery of your order.
body.manualReceived: Your order is already saved. Manual payment and delivery will be arranged.
body.cancelled: The server closed this attempt. You can go back to your bag and check availability before placing another order. If you see a charge on your bank statement, contact the store.
body.pending: Returning to this page does not confirm a charge. We are checking the attempt's status with the store, and your bag is kept in the meantime.

paymentReturn.noReference: We could not find a reference in this tab. If you already paid, contact the store before placing another order.
paymentReturn.footnote: Checking the status never creates a new order.

failures.paymentModeUnavailable: This payment method is not available.
failures.storeUpdating: The store is being updated. Reload this page before placing an order.
failures.paymentOptions: We could not check the available payment methods.
failures.orderNotFound: We could not find a confirmed order. Check your details and submit again; we are keeping the same reference to avoid duplicates.
failures.stillVerifying: Your order is still being verified. Wait a moment and check again before placing another order.
failures.resumeFailed: We could not verify the attempt. Your bag and the same reference are kept.
failures.storageUnavailable: We need this tab's storage to recover your order safely. Enable it and try again.
failures.paymentUrlMissing: Your order is registered, but we have not received a payment link yet. Use Resume payment to check the same attempt.
failures.submitFailed: We could not confirm the result. Your bag is kept so the same order can be recovered.
failures.paymentUrlInvalid: We did not receive a valid payment link.
failures.paymentUrlUnverified: We could not verify the payment link. Your order will not be created again.
failures.returnVerifyFailed: We could not verify the payment yet. Your attempt is still saved.
